lines: Saamne hai jo use log bura kehte hain
couplets.en: People speak ill of the one before their eyes.

lines: Jisko dekha hi nahin, usko Khuda kehte hain
couplets.en: The one they have never seen, they call God.

lines: Zindagi ko bhi sila kehte hain kehne waale
couplets.en: There are those who call life itself a reward.

lines: Jeene waale to gunaahon ki saza kehte hain
couplets.en: Those who live it call it punishment for their sins.

lines: Jisko dekha hi nahin, usko Khuda kehte hain
couplets.en: The one they have never seen, they call God.

lines: Faasle umr ke kuchh aur badha deti hai
couplets.en: It stretches the distance between the years a little further.

lines: Jaane kyun log use phir bhi dawa kehte hain
couplets.en: Who knows why people still call it a remedy?

lines: Jisko dekha hi nahin, usko Khuda kehte hain
couplets.en: The one they have never seen, they call God.

lines: Chand maasoom se patton ka lahu hai, Faakir
couplets.en: It is the blood of a few innocent leaves, Faakir.

lines: Jisko mehboob ke haathon ki hina kehte hain
couplets.en: They call it henna on the hands of the beloved.
